# CHANGELOG for v79 - esp32c3
## ✨ New Features
* Added support for Matter protocol over Wi-Fi and Ethernet
* Implemented device provisioning using QR code scanning
* Introduced a new API for custom device firmware updates

## 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Fixed a bug causing occasional Wi-Fi disconnections on ESP32C3 modules
* Resolved an issue with incorrect timestamping in device logs
* Corrected a problem with incomplete data transmission over UART

## 🔐 Security
* Identified and documented a secret found in the codebase, which will be addressed in the next release
* Confirmed zero critical CVEs affecting the current firmware version
* Noted a security score of 0/10, indicating a need for significant security enhancements

## ⚡ Performance
* Optimized flash memory usage, resulting in 43.9% utilization
* Identified a potential saving of 95 KB in flash memory
* Improved device boot time by reducing unnecessary initialization steps

## 🔍 Code Quality
* Generated four new tests to improve code coverage and ensure functionality
* Conducted a review of code quality, highlighting areas for improvement
* Applied coding standards and best practices for ESP-IDF development

## ✅ Quality Gates
* Successfully built the firmware release with no errors
* Confirmed the absence of AI patches in this release
* Validated the release against a set of predefined quality gates

## ⚠️ Known Issues
* The security score of 0/10 indicates a high risk of security vulnerabilities
* The presence of a secret in the codebase poses a security risk
* Wi-Fi connectivity issues may still occur in certain scenarios

## 🔜 Next Release
* Address the secret found in the codebase to improve security
* Apply necessary patches to enhance the security score
* Focus on optimizing performance and reducing flash memory usage
